evidence_statement: The VR training objectives were developed from OSHA and WorkSafe guidelines (Section 3.3).

evidence_statement: The VR system required Oculus Quest and a 3m×3m physical space (Sections 3, 3.2).

evidence_statement: The Manual group showed significant knowledge decay from post-training to retention (p=0.030), consistent with the forgetting curve (Section 5.4.1).
